description: This header file defines classes and structures related to resolving and managing configurations for resolutions within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including the Resolver class and associated data structures.

classes.name: ConfigContainer
classes.description: A container class for holding the resolutions configuration, inheriting from JSON::Container, with a JSON variant member for resolutions.

classes.name: Resolution
classes.description: A struct representing resolution details including alias, event, permission group, additional context, and flags for context inclusion and RPC use.

classes.name: Resolver
classes.description: A class responsible for loading, managing, and resolving resolution configurations, including methods for checking support for RPC, events, context, and permissions.

methods.name: LoadConfig
methods.description: Loads resolution configurations from a JSON file specified by path.

methods.name: IsConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the resolver has been properly configured.

methods.name: ResolveAlias
methods.description: Resolves a request string to an alias.

methods.name: CallThunderPlugin
methods.description: Calls a Thunder plugin with specified alias and parameters, returning the response.

methods.name: HasComRpcRequestSupport
methods.description: Checks if a given key supports ComRPC requests.

methods.name: HasEvent
methods.description: Checks if an event exists for a given key.

methods.name: HasIncludeContext
methods.description: Checks if includeContext is enabled for a given key and retrieves additional context.

methods.name: HasPermissionGroup
methods.description: Checks if a permission group is enabled for a given key.

methods.name: ParseAlias
methods.description: Parses an alias into callsign and plugin method.

methods.name: ExtractStringField
methods.description: Helper to extract a string field from a JSON variant container.

methods.name: ExtractBooleanField
methods.description: Helper to extract a boolean field from a JSON variant container.

methods.name: ExtractAdditionalContext
methods.description: Extracts additional context from a JSON object.
